{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for SEVERE disease
has_severe = df['severity'].isin(['severe']).any()

# Check sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

# Check for duplicate patient_id
duplicate_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Report findings
print(f'Has SEVERE disease: {has_severe}')
print(f'Number of -999 sentinel values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}')"}
